answer: Identity here is a behavior, not a badge. The ledger samples how each wallet moves - the jitter of its arrivals, the fees it picks, the spread of its counterparties - and merges accounts that wander in lockstep into a single weight. A jade ring knocked on the door twice a day at the same hour reads as one hand; a reef of cloned wallets collapses to one voice however tidy its rows. Attackers mint addresses for free, but buying thousands of decorrelated, human-tempoed histories is not.
